brief.statement: Drone survey work, explained for the people who buy it,
brief.muted: with a short path to starting a project.

body: UAVOps collects and processes aerial data for organisations across Africa, in research, forestry, mining, agriculture, oil and gas, energy, construction and surveying.
What clients receive are working files: orthomosaics, NDVI layers, terrain models and 3D visualisations.
The homepage opens on an industry switcher, then sets out the problem (incomplete, outdated data) and the method: plan, collect, process and analyse, act.
The services page covers ten service lines, each with its own deliverables and a Request service button.

list: A multi-step project form with a progress bar: contact, industry, then scope, dates, site and the outputs needed.
Book a call opens a 30-minute Calendly slot.
A resources library of news, guides, case studies and blog posts, filterable by type.

notes.title: Ten services, one request form.
items: Tabs under the hero move between research, forestry, mining, agriculture, oil and gas, energy, construction and surveying.
The method is set out step by step, with mission-planning and processed-map imagery.
Each service line lists what the client gets, from orthomosaic maps to boundary surveys.
Articles, news, guides and case studies are published from the CMS into one resources library.
